name: slasher-stab-section
style: instrumental horror film cue, small dry string orchestra only, 1960 black-and-white thriller recording, close mono-feeling room. Opens in near silence, just a held low double-bass note, barely audible. Then muted violin section in shrieking high staccato stabs on one repeated note, hard downbows like a knife, each stab smeared with a slashing upward glissando. Stabs come in tight bursts of two or three, black silence between bursts, the gaps shrinking toward the end. Grinding semitone cluster chords, violas and cellos rubbing a half step apart, never resolving. Ends on a loud dissonant cluster stab cut off dead, no reverb tail. Tense, cold, no melody, no vocals
